title: Research trial accounting record
description: One row of the research-selection ledger (research/trial_ledger.py). Distinguishes FAMILY / LINEAGE / CANDIDATE / CONFIG / EXPERIMENT / RUN / TRIAL so that one winning config never erases the attempts that did not win. A PREREGISTERED record must exist, appended and hash-chained, before any terminal record for the same trial_id may be appended; research/trial_ledger.py enforces that ordering, this schema only enforces the shape of one record.

purpose.description: Why this trial exists, declared at preregistration and repeated verbatim on every later record for the same trial_id, so a reader never has to trust that the stated purpose was not rewritten after the outcome was known.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the frozen config/parameter identity, where one exists.

deterministic_seed.description: Fixed seed for any pseudo-random element of this trial (e.g. a null control), or null when none is used.

outcome.description: Present only on a terminal record (state != PREREGISTERED). Never present on a PREREGISTERED record — a preregistration that already carries an outcome is not a preregistration.
